title: Ines and the Verdict
author: Silas Villalobos
blurb: Petra Zhou, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
